text:
A disorder of mood and affect in which the predominant emotion is
sadness/unhappiness It can occur alone (unipolar depression) or as part of an
alternation disorder in which elevation of mood also occurs (bipolar disorder).
Varies in severity from mild to severe. Occurs in about 2 - 5% of the population
at any given time and in about 10 - 25% in their lifetime. Women are generally
at an elevated risk
